exposure: management approach for placenta accreta spectrum (multidisciplinary with fixed team vs. multidisciplinary with varying team vs. pre-multidisciplinary approach)
cohort: Women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum between October 2003 and December 2020 at Sahlgrenska University Hospital
finding: The multidisciplinary management and surgical method for placenta accreta spectrum at Sahlgrenska University Hospital have lowered blood loss and the need for transfusions, even over time, regardless of team structure.
